name: – David McAllister – § 74 – Am 164
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: 74. Emphasises that the countries of the EU, Latin American and the Caribbean are like-minded and share values, languages, history, culture and religion, which should make them natural partners in today’s geopolitical context; notes, with great concern, the ongoing and severe decline in fundamental rights and freedoms, security and living conditions in many Latin American countries, owing to the spread of socialism; highlights that authoritarianism is especially severe in the region, in totalitarian regimes such as those in Venezuela, Cuba and Nicaragua; calls for strong support to the democratic opposition in the above-mentioned regimes; urges the immediate suspension of any financial aid to those regimes; notes that the EU’s engagement in the region has dwindled in recent decades, which has created a vacuum for the growing influence of China and Russia; urges countries across Latin America to adopt a firmer attitude of condemnation of Russia’s aggression against Ukraine; calls on the Member States to pursue proactive diplomacy in the region, with a strong emphasis on defending the multilateral global order, international law and respect for democracy and human rights; urges for multilateral initiatives to address political instability in the most volatile countries in the region, for instance in Haiti;
